modules.title: Arabic Daily Essentials — أساسيات العربية اليومية
modules.description: Foundational spoken Arabic for everyday greetings, hospitality, and daily life

lessons.title: Greetings & Polite Etiquette — التَّحِيَّاتُ وَالتَّعَارُف
lessons.scenario: Meeting a friend, neighbor, or host in an Arabic-speaking city for the first time.
lessons.objective: Master foundational Arabic greetings, reciprocal pleasantries, and introducing yourself
samplePhrases: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ — وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام
أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا، تَشَرَّفْنَا بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ
كَيْفَ حَالُكَ اليَوْم؟ — بِخَيْرٍ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّه
مَا اسْمُكَ؟ — اِسْمِي...
transliterations: Kayfa ḥāluk al-yawm? — Bi-khayr, al-ḥamdu lillāh

bridgeNotes.en: In Arabic culture, greetings are warm and reciprocal. Always respond to 'As-salamu alaykum' with 'Wa alaykumu s-salam'.
bridgeNotes.ta: அரபு கலாச்சாரத்தில் முகமன் கூறுவது மிக முக்கியம். ஸலாம் கூறும்போது அதே அன்போடு பதிலளிக்க வேண்டும்.

lessons.title: At the Traditional Cafe — فِي المَقْهَى التَّقْلِيدِيّ
lessons.scenario: You are at a local cafe in Cairo or Amman ordering traditional drinks and a pastry.
lessons.objective: Practice ordering coffee, tea, clarifying sweetness preferences, and asking for the bill
samplePhrases: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، أُرِيدُ فِنْجَانَ قَهْوَةٍ عَرَبِيَّة
هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ شَايٌ بِالنَّعْنَاعِ الأَخْضَر؟
بِدُونِ سُكَّر، لَوْ سَمَحْت
كَمِ الحِسَابُ، مِنْ فَضْلِك؟ — شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا
transliterations: Min faḍlik, urīdu finjāna qahwah ʿarabiyyah
Kam al-ḥisāb, min faḍlik? — Shukran jazīlan

bridgeNotes.en: Use 'min fadlik' (please) when requesting, and 'shukran jazilan' (thank you very much) when served.
bridgeNotes.ta: காபி அல்லது தேநீர் ஆர்டர் செய்யும் போது 'மின் ஃபள்லிக்' (தயவுசெய்து) என்று தொடங்குவது மரபு.

lessons.title: Directions & City Life — فِي السُّوقِ وَالاتِّجَاهَات
lessons.scenario: You are navigating a bustling historic souq and asking a local for directions to the market plaza.
lessons.objective: Ask for directions, understand left/right/straight cues, and practice polite inquiries
samplePhrases: عَفْوًا، أَيْنَ المَتْحَفُ الوَطَنِيّ؟
هَلْ هُوَ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ هُنَا؟
اِتَّجِهْ يَمِينًا ثُمَّ إِلَى الأَمَام
جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا عَلَى المُسَاعَدَة

bridgeNotes.en: Yamīnan means right, Yasāran means left, and Ilā l-amām means straight ahead.
bridgeNotes.ta: யமீனன் என்றால் வலது, யசாரன் என்றால் இடது, இலா அல்-அமாம் என்றால் நேராக.

modules.title: Hospitality & Conversation — الضِّيَافَةُ وَالحِوَار
modules.description: Expressing opinions, welcoming guests, and sharing personal experiences in Arabic

lessons.title: Welcoming Guests & Hospitality — كَرَمُ الضِّيَافَة
lessons.scenario: You are hosting friends at your home for an evening gathering.
lessons.objective: Practice traditional expressions of Arabic hospitality and offering refreshments
samplePhrases: أَهْلًا وَمَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ فِي بَيْتِنَا
تَفَضَّلُوا، البَيْتُ بَيْتُكُمْ
مَا رَأْيُكُمْ فِي تَجْرِبَةِ هَذَا الطَّبَقِ التَّقْلِيدِيّ؟
شَرَّفْتُمُونَا بِهَذِهِ الزِّيَارَةِ الكَرِيمَة
transliterations: Ahlan wa marḥaban bikum fī baytinā
Mā raʾyukum fī tajribati hādhā ṭ-ṭabaqi t-taqlīdī?

bridgeNotes.en: 'Al-baytu baytukum' (our home is your home) is a timeless Arabian expression of profound hospitality.

modules.title: Everyday Essentials (English)
modules.description: Foundational spoken interactions for daily life

lessons.title: Ordering at a Cafe
lessons.scenario: You are at a local coffee shop ordering a drink and snack.
lessons.objective: Practice polite requests and clarifying preferences
samplePhrases: Could I please have a cappuccino?
Do you have oat milk available?
How much does that come to?

bridgeNotes.ta: கஃபேவில் மரியாதையாக காபி ஆர்டர் செய்யும் உரையாடல்.
bridgeNotes.ar: طلب قهوة بأدب في مقهى محلي.

lessons.title: Asking for Directions
lessons.scenario: You are near the central station looking for the library.
lessons.objective: Practice asking location questions and understanding directional cues
samplePhrases: Excuse me, could you tell me where the library is?
Is it within walking distance?
Thank you for your help!

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.scenario: You meet a new colleague or neighbor for the first time.
lessons.objective: Share your name, where you live, and what you enjoy doing
samplePhrases: Hello! It is a pleasure to meet you.
I recently moved here from Chennai.
What do you enjoy doing on weekends?

modules.title: Workplace & Collaboration
modules.description: Clear and polite communication in professional settings

lessons.title: Project Standup Update
lessons.scenario: You are giving a 2-minute status update to your project team.
lessons.objective: Summarize yesterday's progress, today's goals, and potential blockers
samplePhrases: Yesterday I completed the initial draft.
Today I am focusing on testing the edge cases.
I do not anticipate any major blockers right now.

lessons.title: Politely Declining a Meeting
lessons.scenario: You have a conflict and need to reschedule a discussion.
lessons.objective: Acknowledge the invite, decline respectfully, and propose an alternative
samplePhrases: Thank you for the invite. Unfortunately, I have a prior commitment.
Would Thursday morning work better for you?
I appreciate your flexibility.

modules.title: Persuasion & Discussion
modules.description: Expressing opinions, nuance, and constructive feedback

lessons.title: Navigating a Difference of Opinion
lessons.scenario: You and a partner disagree on the best solution for a problem.
lessons.objective: Validate their perspective while articulating your rationale clearly
samplePhrases: I see your point regarding speed, but reliability is our key risk.
What if we phased the rollout to mitigate that concern?
Let's look at the data before making the final call.
